findings.description: The code uses http:// which allows eavesdropping and MITM.
Even if switching to HTTPS, you must ensure certificate and hostname verification are enabled.
The callback multiplies size * nmemb without guarding against overflow, which can lead to incorrect copy lengths.
The callback multiplies size * nmemb without guarding against overflow, which can lead to incorrect copy lengths.
curl_easy_setopt and other libcurl calls aren’t checked; failures can silently degrade security or change behavior.
libcurl, by default, writes response bodies to stdout, which can leak sensitive data into logs/console. Provide a write callback and bound the memory allocated for responses.
No timeouts set; requests may hang indefinitely and tie up resources.
